body.x: ARCHT One features patented sound array technology to replicate live musical performances

ARCHT Audio, developer of wireless audio systems, is exhibiting its all-in-one wireless speaker ARCHT One (pronounced ARK). The design of ARCHT One is based on the company's patented Sound Array technology, which evenly disperses sound throughout a room, and delivers a dynamic audio experience.

ARCHT One's distinctive design and multidirectional Sound Array technology dispels the notion that optimum sound can only be enjoyed from a specific location in a room -- place the speaker anywhere and enjoy sound everywhere. At the push of a button, you can control playback of music directly on the ARCHT One or via an iOS app. The iOS app uses a location-based optimization sensor to calibrate the speaker based on your surroundings. Choose from connections such as Wi-Fi, AirPlay, Bluetooth, and direct USB or AUX, which allow anyone to stream music to ARCHT One via their laptops, tablets or mobile devices. AirPlay and Wi-Fi connections, in particular, allow you to stream and enjoy your music in high-quality formats -- turn the music up and enjoy the true acoustics of each song.

"We are music lovers that wanted to change the way music is seen and heard -- we've done that with ARCHT One," said Evan Foo, CEO of ARCHT Audio. "Consumers can seamlessly incorporate the speakers aesthetically-pleasing design into their homes and enjoy consistent, high-quality sound. With the iOS app, you can recalibrate ARCHT One and optimize the sound based on the room's acoustics so you can hear and experience each musical note without interruption."
To learn more about the company and the product, visit www.archtaudio.com.
